correct_completion: I will reply to you soon.
full_sentence: Thank you for your message, I will reply to you soon.
acceptable_variants: I will write back to you soon.
I will answer your email soon.

options.text: I am going to the market now.
options.why_wrong: This introduces an unrelated activity and does not respond to the message the writer has just thanked the reader for.

options.text: my cat is sleeping on the sofa.
options.why_wrong: This starts a new topic that has no connection to the email, so it does not complete the response.

options.text: I hope you are doing well.
options.why_wrong: This is a common greeting, but it does not state what the writer will do next in response to the message.

options.text: I will reply to you soon.

grammar_focus: Responding to a message in an informal email
explanation: After the thanks, the writer usually states a clear next action, such as replying. Learners sometimes add a new topic because they expect a longer message, but a short reply promise is the natural continuation here.
translation: Mesajın için teşekkür ederim, sana yakında cevap vereceğim.
